newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF 400 METRES HURDLES CHAMPION BIDOUANE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF 400 METRES HURDLES CHAMPION BIDOUANE.

text.p: Profile of Moroccan Nezha Bidouane, who won the world women's 400 metres hurdles title on Friday.

Made her mark first in 1990 by winning the African championship but was not able to go further than the semifinals at the 1991 world championships and 1992 Barcelona Olympics and went out in the heats in the 1993 world championships in Stuttgart.
Friday's victory was the first major triumph for the African record holder.
She is married to steeplechaser Abdelaziz Sahere and trains at altitude at Ifrane.
